meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步任务写进计划文件,让 AI 助手一步步推进并随时回看进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 助手有条理地处理需要多步操作、容易丢进度的复杂任务。
copy.tagline_en: Keep multi-step tasks on track with file-based plans you can resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to preserve progress across long, multi-step tasks.

howto.what: Claude 会把多步任务的计划、发现和进度分别写进 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md,并反复读取维护;操作后提醒更新进度,压缩上下文前提醒同步,计划文件被篡改时会拦截并提示。
howto.when: 当被要求规划、拆解或组织多步骤项目、研究任务,或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发;对话开始时若已有计划文件会自动读取。

say.text: 帮我规划这个 8 步研究任务,建好 task_plan.md
say.note: Claude 会创建计划文件并开始逐步执行。

say.text: 刚才的调研结果记入 findings.md
say.note: 发现信息会被写到磁盘上。

say.text: 压缩前请更新 progress.md 和 task_plan.md 状态
say.note: 确保磁盘记录是最新进度。

howto.what_en: Claude keeps plans, findings, progress in task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md on disk; reads plan before decisions, reminds updates after actions and before compaction, and blocks tampered plan injection.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project/research or any task requiring 5+ tool calls; existing planning files are auto-loaded at session start.

say_en.text: Plan this 8-step research task and create task_plan.md
say_en.note: Claude will create the plan file and start acting.

say_en.text: Update progress.md and task_plan.md before context compression
